title: Real-time event-level zero-shot learning at 150 ns: towards a foundation model for particle physics experiment triggering
abstract: arXiv:2611.28355v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The hardware-based Level-1 triggers of the Large Hadron Collider (LHC) experiments select collisions with algorithms designed for one signature each, acting on a coarse, low-latency view of every event. We present a learned event embedding for several trigger tasks and evaluate its transfer to processes absent from training. Using paired offline and Level-1 views of the same simulated collisions, we train an offline transformer with a supervised metric loss and distil it, event by event, into a quantised Level-1 transformer whose bit widths are learned under a fixed resource budget. Trained on 25 Standard Model processes, the embedding places 28 held-out processes next to their physical relatives. A nearest-neighbour selection against background collisions, which never enter encoder training, rejects 99% of them. It retains a median of 90% of seen and 96% of unseen Standard Model events and 88% of a set of 52 beyond-the-Standard-Model

translated_title: 150纳秒内的实时事件级零样本学习：迈向粒子物理实验触发的基础模型
translated_abstract: 大型强子对撞机（LHC）实验的硬件化一级触发器采用针对单一信号特征分别设计的算法来筛选碰撞事件，其作用对象是每个事件的粗糙、低延迟视图。我们提出了一种面向多个触发任务的学习型事件嵌入方法，并评估其对训练中未出现的物理过程的迁移能力。利用同一模拟碰撞事件的离线视图与一级触发视图的配对数据，我们以监督度量损失训练一个离线Transformer，并逐事件将其蒸馏到一个量化的一级触发Transformer中，其位宽在固定资源预算下通过学习确定。该嵌入在25个标准模型过程上训练后，能够将28个留出的过程放置在其物理近邻旁边。针对从未进入编码器训练的背景碰撞进行最近邻筛选，可拒绝其中99%。该模型对已见和未见的标准模型事件分别保留中位数90%和96%的效率，并对包含52个超出标准模型事件的数据集保留88%的效率（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种可在150纳秒内实时运行的事件嵌入基础模型方法，通过离线Transformer的监督度量学习与量化蒸馏，实现对训练中未见过的标准模型及超出标准模型物理过程的零样本触发筛选，背景拒绝率达99%。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a real-time (150 ns) event-embedding approach toward a foundation model for particle physics triggering, achieving zero-shot generalization to unseen Standard Model and beyond-the-Standard-Model processes by distilling a metric-learned offline transformer into a quantised Level-1 trigger, with 99% background rejection.
